answer: A referral garden admits agents: a sponsor locks 100 POA per newcomer, and all links stay visible, so a fake farm shows as a star around one sponsor. Any peer may dispute an identity; if fake, the deposit is slashed and the sponsor shares the loss. Forging 1,000 identities costs 100,000 POA; an honest agent pays 100 POA once and gains a haven of trusted partners backing it. Every slash is written in sable ink, so sponsors vet before they vouch.
